ds.t: So says the wise sadhu: Pramukh Swami Maharaj on good reading
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Read the Vachanamrut every day. Think about what comes in it. Until the secret is understood, there is no benefit in reading. If we read with reflection, the mind definitely turns back. Read and repeat. If we keep imbibing it more and more in this way, the spiritual principle becomes firm."

ds.t: Says the wise sadhu: nectar from Pramukh Swami Maharaj on good reading
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj said: "Read the Vachanamrut every day. Reflect on what comes in it. Until the inner meaning is understood, reading is of no benefit. If we read with reflection, the mind certainly turns back inward. Read and repeat. If we absorb it more and more in this way, the spiritual principle becomes firm."

ds.t: Thus says the wise Sant: on reading good books
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Read the Vachanamrut every day. Reflect on what comes in it. Until one understands its secret, reading does not bring benefit. If we read with reflection, the mind is sure to turn back. After reading, repeat it. If we imbibe it more and more in this way, the spiritual principles become firm."

ds.t: So says the wise sadhu... A sip of the nectar Pramukh Swami Maharaj showered on good reading
w: "Read the Vachanamrut every day. Reflect on what is in it. Until one understands its secret, reading does not bring benefit. If we read with reflection, the mind certainly turns back inward. After reading, repeat it. If we imbibe it more and more in this way, the spiritual principle becomes firm," said Pramukh Swami Maharaj.
During the morning assembly, a committee of 80 organizations of Junagadh district honored Swamishri by presenting a proclamation.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
A satsangi youth observed an 84 hour waterless fast for Swamishri’s good health.
30 satsangi children prostrated 15 km from the suburb of Nikol to the mandir.
A devotee pilgrimaged 65 km by foot from his village of Chadasan. A volunteer observed a waterless fast for 82 hours for Swamishri’s good health.

Two satsangi youths performed 1561 prostrations from the suburb of Meghaninagar to the mandir. 90 female devotees from the suburb of Nava Vadaj pilgrimaged by foot to the mandir for Swamishri’s good health. 5 satsangi female youths observed a waterless fast for 84 hours.

29 satsangi children and youth observed a waterless fast. 48 satsangi female children and youth observed a waterless fast. 12 satsangi children from Balambha village observed a waterless fast and 16 children chanted 8,400 rosaries for Swamishri’s good health.
